name: numi-lab
description: Operate and extend the Apple-native Numi Lab suite: robotics, physics, NumiVivo chemistry, NumiTissue, NumiBrain, NumanX, biomechanics, and artificial life.

interface.shortDescription: Your Apple-native physics, biology, and robotics laboratory.
interface.longDescription: Turn natural-language research intent into local workflows across Numi Lab, NumiVivo molecular simulation and chemistry, NumiTissue, NumiBrain, NumanX, Numi Human, Matter, neural cultures, BirdFlow, and Numi Automata. Discover each installed tool, preserve native execution ownership, and retain reproducible evidence. Companion runtimes are resolved separately; this skill does not install them or expose a hosted execution service.
capabilities: Neural culture and virtual MEA research
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Numi Lab suite and show which tools are available.
Use NumiVivo to inspect a prepared molecular system and choose a supported workflow.
Trace a NumiVivo, NumiTissue, NumiBrain, and NumanX experiment through its owning tools.
